felucca.status: Unfinished reference work left untouched. Diagnostic 05 FM-1 peripheral MIDI output owner-confirmed; Diagnostic 07 masked/IRQ-context mutex assertion and Diagnostic 08 watchdog exception unresolved.

reconciliation.finding: Hortator is a central/GATT client connecting to MIDI peripherals. Our previous Felucca experiment advertises a peripheral GATT service to phones. Hortator's outbound queue accepts 1-3 byte MIDI messages, not game files.
reconciliation.action: Use the role-independent Hortator OS/HAL approach with a peripheral data service informed by our existing service and callback tests. Do not copy the central profile unchanged.

reconciliation.finding: Hortator runs btstack_init inside a cooperative app_core task, with guarded stacks, main-loop service and nested interrupt masking. Our experiment uses the full SDK diagnostic runtime and a mutex-protected RAM config backend.
reconciliation.action: Evaluate Hortator's integration while retaining our fault/start traces. This does not prove the old assertion's cause. Do not copy cpu_in_irq() returning zero as a substitute for correct IRQ-context handling.

reconciliation.finding: Hortator validates VM item 187, a 68-byte RF calibration record, read-only from FM-1 0xE5000..0xFC000. It bypasses fresh trimming which upstream reports hangs/crashes. No equivalent persisted RF scan was found in our experiment overlay; it reads the FM-1 factory Bluetooth address at 0xE9000.
reconciliation.action: Identify each board's own stored RF record and address. Do not assume FM-1 offsets on SMK or substitute another unit's calibration.

reconciliation.finding: Hortator FIT.md records roughly 125-127 KiB extra image, a 13824-byte heap configuration and four task stacks. These are upstream measurements, not a NESynth BLE link.
reconciliation.action: Current 512 KiB template cannot simply accept BLE. Measure an opt-in loader mode reusing emulation buffers and a smaller initial cartridge slot, or design a verified new storage layout. Preserve current public ROM capacity until that design is complete.

reconciliation.finding: Neither reference implements a validated wireless NES cartridge receiver.
reconciliation.action: Share a bounded BEGIN/DATA/STATUS/COMMIT receiver across USB and BLE, with offsets, lengths, ROM validation, checksums, duplicate handling and interruption recovery. Separate emulator and cartridge storage. Persistent game replacement still writes flash; it avoids reinstalling the emulator, not storage writes.

Initially use BLE in the front loader only. Verify radio/task teardown or reboot into radio-off gameplay. Retain CPU1 scaling, asynchronous LCD and SMK scanner divider 95. A multi-game library needs a separate capacity decision; begin with one replaceable game.
